function_v0.doc:
Execute one atomic cyclic arbitrage.

* `profit_token` - the anchor asset that opens and closes the cycle
(normally native XLM's SAC). Principal is pulled from the admin and the
full closing balance is returned to the admin.
* `amount_in`    - principal to pull from the admin.
* `min_profit`   - required surplus; the tx reverts unless the closing
balance >= amount_in + min_profit.
* `hops`         - ordered venue swaps; each pulls its input from this
contract and leaves its output here for the next hop.
function_v0.name: run

function_v0.doc: One-time: set the admin (the bot's Stellar account).
function_v0.name: init

function_v0.doc: Recover stranded dust (drift surplus of any token) to the admin.
function_v0.name: sweep
